_comments.title: 2D Transverse Field Ising Model (TFIM) Benchmarks.
_comments.nx: Number of qubits along the grid's x-direction (columns).
_comments.ny: Number of qubits along the grid's y-direction (rows).
_comments.hz: Longitudinal (Z) field strength, i.e. the Hamiltonian's tilt.
_comments.j: ZZ coupling strength between nearest-neighbor qubits.
_comments.step_min: First Trotter step number to simulate (exclusive).
_comments.step_max: Last Trotter step number to simulate (inclusive).
_comments.lower_atol: Coefficient magnitude below which Pauli terms are truncated.
_comments.cutoff: Maximum Pauli weight to keep during propagation; null disables weight truncation.
_comments.obs_qubits: Indexed qubit pair for the ZZ observable, row-major over the nx-by-ny grid.
